title: A Short Visit and a Weekend Plan · 独立口语迁移
instructions: 先完成示范段的跟读诊断，再用不同人物、信息或立场录制自己的完整回答。示范与自由回答分别取证，服务未提供完整听音评阅时保持待评。
reference: Last Saturday, Lily visited her grandmother. The weather was sunny and warm. They were in the garden. Lily was happy. Her grandmother was happy, too. They picked red apples. Then they made apple pie. It was very good. Lily said, "Thank you!" Now Lily is going to visit again next Sunday. She is going to bring a book. They are going to read together. Lily is going to take the bus because her bike is broken.
prompt:
Did you visit a family member last week?
What was the weather like yesterday?
Are you going to do something fun next weekend?
Why are you learning English?
